providers.reason: The company reported a strong Q3 beat on October 13 and raised full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $20.50. The stock is exhibiting robust post-earnings momentum (10/10 rank) as it recovers toward its 52-week high. Improving medical care ratios and AI-driven operational efficiencies are currently outweighing regulatory headwinds in Medicare Advantage.
providers.risk: Elevated commercial medical cost trends and ongoing regulatory scrutiny of insurer margins.

providers.reason: Q3 adjusted EPS $4.69 beat $4.14 with medical-cost ratio down to 88.4%, and management raised FY26 EPS guidance to at least $20.50, the third raise this year. Post-earnings drift is reinforced by target hikes (Mizuho $493 'top pick', Evercore $480, Barclays $440) versus a ~$387 price.
providers.risk: Medical-cost trend or Medicare Advantage policy headlines could reverse the turnaround narrative; the stock has already jumped post-print, so near-term upside may be partly priced.

providers.reason: Post-Q3 earnings momentum with raised 2026 guidance to $20.50+ EPS. Medical cost ratio improved to 88.4%, beating estimates. Price target raised to $498 (20% upside from current $416). Strong technical setup following earnings beat.
providers.risk: Post-earnings consolidation or profit-taking after recent 10% surge could limit near-term upside in short 2-5 day window.
